dedupe_keys.name: cibse weather data sets for building simulation 2016 and 2025 releases

description: CIBSE sells weather files for building performance modelling in the United Kingdom. The 2025 release uses observations from 1994 to 2023, adds UKCP18 projections for the 2030s, 2050s and 2080s, expands coverage from 16 locations to 28 climate zones, and uses ERA5 solar radiation. Version 1.1 of the 2025 files corrected horizontal infrared radiation values that affected v1.0 files in DesignBuilder and EnergyPlus, and CIBSE advises rerunning simulations. The 2016 CIBSE weather data sets remain the ones required for compliance with Parts L and O of the Building Regulations, and TM59 (2017) overheating assessments still use them, while TM59 (2026) needs the 2025 files. Coverage: UK climate zones, present and future. Access: purchase through the online Weather Data Selection Tool, with a pricing chart and technical briefing. Licence: commercial. Caveats: the new files are not yet required for compliance, and pricing changed for the 2025 release. Simulation uses: overheating and energy compliance simulation for UK buildings, and future-climate stress tests. Related records: Meteonorm Climate and WeatherShift future weather files.
